story_plan.thesis: Conditional Bitcoin watch: easing Treasury yields can be discussed as a possible reduction in the opportunity cost of a non-interest-bearing asset, but cannot by itself establish demand for Bitcoin or a recovery. Distinguish the rate backdrop from willingness to accept volatility. Do not assert an observed Bitcoin move, weakening risk appetite, policy transmission or empirical correlation. The October 1 SEC custody proposal remains dated proposal background, never a final rule or fresh catalyst.

photo_plan.acquisition: Existing media owner only; preserve original capture and rights clocks. No new photo acquisition performed by Light.
photo_plan.proposal: Reuse the held authentic Federal Reserve building archive photograph if the exact existing media record establishes original bytes, source, license, creator/credit and depicted date. Label it archive macro context; it does not depict Bitcoin trading, this week policy action or investor behavior. MAX judges relevance and may omit it if weak. Never use agency logos or infer photo rights from agency text rights.

chart_plan.series: Official daily nominal constant-maturity 10-year Treasury par yield; percent per year, one consistent maturity and definition.
chart_plan.purpose: Show the dated US Treasury yield backdrop without implying a Bitcoin reaction.
chart_plan.placement: Adjacent to the explanation of the Treasury backdrop; the caption must say that it shows Treasury yields, not Bitcoin performance.
chart_plan.window: Use exact held observations and their original capture clock through November 4, 2026. MAX chooses the useful visible start within that admitted capture; identify the final observation date prominently. Do not interpolate missing business days or extend beyond available data.
chart_plan.computation: Code extracts admitted rows, checks dates, units and missingness, and computes any displayed basis-point change from exact endpoints. No BTC overlay, fitted relationship or invented real-yield series.

chart_plan.purpose: Make the two distinct tests understandable without suggesting measured relationships.
chart_plan.content: Use only facts admitted into the actual final article: the dated Treasury observation or change, dated SEC Investor.gov description of spot Bitcoin ETP exposure and volatility risk, and the verified BLS release-calendar fact if relevant. Clearly separate these source facts from conditional watch questions. No scores, arrows claiming observed BTC direction, inferred probabilities or invented price.
chart_plan.placement: After the conditional-watch explanation. MAX selects exact wording and usefulness before rendering.

source_requests.reason: Admit the exact September 9, 2024 SEC Investor.gov bulletin through the existing source owner, including the dated passages describing spot Bitcoin ETP holdings, speculative exposure and volatility. Parent readback is not itself source evidence; bind the exact retained capture and rights.

Reuse the held official 2026 Treasury nominal yield table through November 4 with original capture and known-at clocks. Admit exact dated 10-year observations for one comparable chart and code-owned calculations; do not treat a reread as a fresh observation.

Reuse the held official November 2026 BLS calendar with original capture clocks to establish only the scheduled release date/time relevant to the watch. A calendar does not establish any unreleased jobs result or consensus.
